name: Lovasberény (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lovasberény: a red shield with a white horseman and a castle, supported by two figures, above a scroll inscribed 1765 LOVASBERÉNY 1995.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lovasberény arms with supporters and scroll
